mushroom._doc: MuSHRoom iPhone (zenodo 10230733). Splits: train long_capture minus test.txt; test = test.txt (within); validation = short_capture (cross). dnsplat/ sidecar (prepare_mushroom.py, copied from dn-splatter) + agsmesh/dnc_mask_u8.npy (prepare_dnc.py). NOT rebuildable by bench.py prepare; tools/prepare_rooms.sh <gpu> rooms...

notes: ss-train must get --data (sidecar lookup). --recipe splatstudio (3dgs recipe kNN on 1M points can OOM; plugin sets scales/means LR). ~0.35 s/step on a busy A6000 at 2k steps -> ~2-4 h per room at 30k; ~6-8 GB host RAM for full-res images (sauna 814 frames). Same sidecars also let dn-splatter run the 6-room average.

ablation.note: priors-off ablation, NOT the paper baseline
